rules.name: gap-01-report-tables-discovery
rules.sql: SELECT table_name, table_rows, ROUND(data_length / 1024) AS data_kb, create_time, update_time FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND (table_name REGEXP 'reports[_]product[_]order[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'reports[_]productgroup[_]order[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'reports[_]portfoliogroup[_]order[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'combined[_]report[_]mapping[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'portfoliowise[_]openbalance[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'subportfolio[_]fy[_]opening[_]balance[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'subportfolio[_]fy[_]monthwise[_]opening[_]balance[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'subportfolio[_]fy[_]opening[_]balance[_]actual[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'portfolio[_]region[_]mapping[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'product[_]prcat[_]code[_]mapping[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'counterparty[_]party[_]code[_]mapping[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'dbtodw[_]mapping' OR table_name REGEXP 'eod[_]realised[_]premium[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'client[_]unit[_]name[_]mapping[_]table' OR table_name REGEXP 'netted[_]trades[_]adj[_]value[_]calculation' OR table_name REGEXP 'rbrchn') ORDER BY table_name

SELECT c.relname AS table_name, c.relkind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'v') AND (c.relname IN ('reports_product_order_table', 'reports_productgroup_order_table', 'reports_portfoliogroup_order_table', 'combined_report_mapping_table', 'portfoliowise_openbalance_table', 'client_unit_mapping', 'counterparty_party_code_mapping_table', 'dbtodw_mapping', 'eod_realised_premium_table', 'portfolio_region_mapping_table', 'product_prcat_code_mapping_table', 'subportfolio_fy_monthwise_opening_balance_table', 'subportfolio_fy_opening_balance_actual_table', 'subportfolio_fy_opening_balance_table', 'pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table') OR c.relname LIKE 'netted%trades%adj%value%calculation%' OR c.relname LIKE '%rbrchn%') ORDER BY c.relname

SELECT 'client_unit_mapping' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.client_unit_mapping UNION ALL SELECT 'counterparty_party_code_mapping_table', count(*) FROM opera.counterparty_party_code_mapping_table UNION ALL SELECT 'dbtodw_mapping', count(*) FROM opera.dbtodw_mapping UNION ALL SELECT 'eod_realised_premium_table', count(*) FROM opera.eod_realised_premium_table UNION ALL SELECT 'netted_trades_adj_value_calculation_table', count(*) FROM opera.netted_trades_adj_value_calculation_table UNION ALL SELECT 'netted_trades_adj_value_calculation_terminal_1242_table', count(*) FROM opera.netted_trades_adj_value_calculation_terminal_1242_table UNION ALL SELECT 'netted_trades_rbrchn_table', count(*) FROM opera.netted_trades_rbrchn_table UNION ALL SELECT 'portfolio_region_mapping_table', count(*) FROM opera.portfolio_region_mapping_table UNION ALL SELECT 'product_prcat_code_mapping_table', count(*) FROM opera.product_prcat_code_mapping_table UNION ALL SELECT 'subportfolio_fy_monthwise_opening_balance_table', count(*) FROM opera.subportfolio_fy_monthwise_opening_balance_table UNION ALL SELECT 'subportfolio_fy_opening_balance_actual_table', count(*) FROM opera.subportfolio_fy_opening_balance_actual_table UNION ALL SELECT 'subportfolio_fy_opening_balance_table', count(*) FROM opera.subportfolio_fy_opening_balance_table UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table', count(*) FROM opera.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table

expect.reason: the legacy schema must hold these tables
all 13 tables must exist in PG, otherwise this query fails and the missing name is in the error
